title: Black Pyramid
visualBrief: Whole surviving Black Pyramid collapsed mudbrick core and its intrinsic broken shoulders, gullies and talus, with truncated off-center upper crown. Original medium-fi ruin, not a pristine75m reconstructed pyramid, generic cone or sand hill. Exclude detached temple/enclosure/nearby ruins, underground burial rooms, museum pyramidion, desert/roads/tourism props/people/modern city. Sculpt original closed broken clay-masonry mass with off-center broad truncated head, steep exposed uppercliffs, asymmetric stepped rightshoulder/buttresses, two deep weathered frontgullies and sloping intrinsicmudbrick/rubble aprons. Use actual irregular polygon sections/ridged erosion surfaces/canonicaladobe and earth materials. No ideal pyramid cap, fantasy entrance or generic noisy cone. Height52m/whole envelope112x102m and hidden erosion are explicit photo estimates; native180m circle is only identity. Independent field must remain untouched; if it contains the ruined mound, clip only actual model overlap for host review rather than doubling it or fitting/flattening source values.
